Batch crawl of 2 seed URLs with links to discover

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val engineConfig = mapper.readValue("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", CrawlConfig::class.java)
    val engine = Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig)
    val urls = listOf("https://example.com/seed1", "https://example.com/seed2")
    val result = Crawlberg.batchCrawl(engine, urls)
    println(result.completedCount)
    println(result.failedCount)
    println(result.totalCount)
}
```
